From Empress · Price: it needs a touch to the target's blood (an open wound).

Theme Affliction

  • 1: 2 actions: plant a parasite in a wounded creature (@Check[fortitude|against:stand]{Fortitude} negates). It's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{sickened 1} for 1 minute and can't reduce it below 1 while the parasite lives; a @Check[medicine|against:stand] check against your stand DC (2 actions) cuts it out.
  • 5: The parasite grows into a talking face: the target takes –2 to Deception and Stealth.
  • 9: Surge: the parasite attacks: @Damage[(2*ceil(@actor.level/2))d6[piercing]] (@Check[fortitude|against:stand|basic]{basic Fortitude}), and the target can't Recover from @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{sickened}.
  • 13: Two parasites at once.
  • 17: The parasite also makes the target @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{enfeebled 2}.

Effects @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-stand-class-archetype.stand-effects.Item.ZqKwhHea4guWNVnD]{Effect: Talking Parasite}

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC. A minion an ability makes, unless it says otherwise, is a creature of your level – 2 built with GM Core's Low numbers (Building Creatures), with the minion trait.
